import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a = scanner.nextLong();
        long b = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();

        long i = 1;
        long bx = 0, by = 0;
        long bbi = 1;
        long eps = 1000000000L;

        while (i <= n) {
            long tx = (i * a) / b;

            int j = -5;
            while (j <= 5) {
                long t = tx + j;
                long tbi = b * i;

                if (Math.abs(b * t - a * i) * bbi < eps * tbi) {
                    eps = Math.abs(b * t - a * i);
                    bx = t;
                    by = i;
                    bbi = tbi;
                }
                j++;
            }
            i++;
        }

        System.out.println(bx + "/" + by);
    }
}
